payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of the data collection process using a crowdsourcing platform and the nature of the dialogs collected.

claims.text: The data was collected using the crowdsourcing platform CrowdFlower, where workers interacted with a chat-like interface to answer questions.
The dataset consists of 1900 collected dialogs that simulate interactive learning from user utterances.
The dataset was created to enable training of interactively learned policies through simulated user interactions.
